title: pollen-robotics/microduck
title_zh: 微型双足鸭子机器人 Microduck

paragraphs.en: A tiny biped robot that moves using reinforcement learning policies.
paragraphs.zh: 一个使用强化学习策略进行移动的微型双足机器人。

paragraphs.en: Get yours here · Cheat sheet · Training the policies · How it works · Contributing
paragraphs.zh: 点击此处获取 · 速查表 · 训练策略 · 工作原理 · 参与贡献

paragraphs.en: This repo is the duck's brain. About 25 cm and 800 g of robot, run by a handful of daemons on a Rockchip RK3566: a 50 Hz control loop driving fifteen servos from neural policies, the radios and the camera, and the update machinery that gets new software onto a robot without bricking it.
paragraphs.zh: 本仓库是这只机器鸭的大脑。 这台机器人身高约 25 厘米、重约 800 克，由 Rockchip RK3566 上运行的几个守护进程驱动：一个 50 Hz 的控制回路根据神经策略驱动十五个舵机，此外还负责无线电、摄像头，以及在不把机器人刷坏的前提下将新软件部署到机器人上的更新机制。

sents.en: This repo is the duck's brain.
sents.zh: 本仓库是这只机器鸭的大脑。

sents.en: About 25 cm and 800 g of robot, run by a handful of daemons on a Rockchip RK3566: a 50 Hz control loop driving fifteen servos from neural policies, the radios and the camera, and the update machinery that gets new software onto a robot without bricking it.
sents.zh: 这台机器人身高约 25 厘米、重约 800 克，由 Rockchip RK3566 上运行的几个守护进程驱动：一个 50 Hz 的控制回路根据神经策略驱动十五个舵机，此外还负责无线电、摄像头，以及在不把机器人刷坏的前提下将新软件部署到机器人上的更新机制。

paragraphs.en: Everything you need to run a Microduck is here. If you want one, get yours here .
paragraphs.zh: 运行 Microduck 所需的一切都在这里。 如果你想要一个，就在这里获取你自己的吧。

sents.en: Everything you need to run a Microduck is here.
sents.zh: 运行 Microduck 所需的一切都在这里。

sents.en: If you want one, get yours here .
sents.zh: 如果你想要一个，就在这里获取你自己的吧。

paragraphs.en: The policies it runs are trained next door, in microduck_rl — MuJoCo and PPO, the sim2real recipe, and the export to ONNX that this repo loads.
paragraphs.zh: 它运行的策略是在隔壁的 microduck_rl 中训练的——MuJoCo 和 PPO，即 sim2real 的配方，以及本仓库所加载的导出为 ONNX 的模型。

paragraphs.en: It also sits, kicks a ball, rolls forward on command, and quacks in a voice that is its own.
paragraphs.zh: 它还能坐下、踢球、按指令向前翻滚，并用它自己独特的声音嘎嘎叫。

paragraphs.en: Rust, no framework, one workspace. robotd owns the control loop and the motor bus; updaterd installs signed releases and rolls them back when a robot comes up unhealthy; configd owns wifi and identity; btd is the Bluetooth path a phone uses; padd reads the gamepad; mediad streams the camera over WebRTC; tofd serves the depth sensor. They talk over one JSON-RPC contract on Unix sockets, and every client — the app, the console, the gamepad, your script — sends exactly the same calls.
paragraphs.zh: Rust，不用框架，一个工作区。robotd 负责控制循环和电机总线；updaterd 负责安装签名版本，并在机器人启动状态异常时回滚；configd 负责无线网络和身份；btd 是手机使用的蓝牙通道；padd 读取游戏手柄；mediad 通过 WebRTC 串流摄像头画面；tofd 为深度传感器提供服务。 它们通过 Unix 套接字上的同一个 JSON-RPC 契约进行通信，每个客户端——应用、控制台、游戏手柄、你的脚本——发送的调用完全相同。

sents.en: They talk over one JSON-RPC contract on Unix sockets, and every client — the app, the console, the gamepad, your script — sends exactly the same calls.
sents.zh: 它们通过 Unix 套接字上的同一个 JSON-RPC 契约进行通信，每个客户端——应用、控制台、游戏手柄、你的脚本——发送的调用完全相同。

paragraphs.en: The interesting decisions are written down: docs/design/ is why things are the way they are, and docs/project/ is what has gone wrong and what would close it.
paragraphs.zh: 有意思的决策都被记录下来了：docs/design/ 解释了事情为何是现在这个样子，而 docs/project/ 则记录了出了什么问题以及什么能解决它。

paragraphs.en: No duck was harmed in the making of this robot. Several were consulted.
paragraphs.zh: 本机器人的制作过程中没有伤害任何鸭子。倒是咨询过几只。
